name: Chloe Turner
source:
Your Secretary who just so happens to be the Daughter of your enemy [url=https://vndb.org/c148183]Mr. Turner[/url], but [url=https://vndb.org/c148150]you[/url] suspect their relationship is far from close. She initially seemed to hold her Fathers views of you, but perhaps you can prove her wrong... Or right...
